RIPPERS.Guise.IdentityHint: The persona behind the mask (e.g. Inspector Grange)
RIPPERS.Guise.RoleHint: One-line cover / how it reads on the street
RIPPERS.Guise.DropClass: Drop a class Item here to add it to this guise
RIPPERS.Guise.DropSkill: Drop a skill Item here (allocate its SL below)
RIPPERS.Guise.DropEquip: Drop a weapon / armour / accessory here
RIPPERS.Guise.SwapHint: Click this guise on the character sheet to bind it (dismissing any other). Exactly one guise is active at a time; its skills, equipment and affinities apply only while it is bound.
RIPPERS.Guise.DormancyHint: While this guise is bound, your own innate skills sleep — only the mask's allocated skills are live (one 30-level set at a time). Dismiss the guise to wake them.
RIPPERS.Benefit.ChooseUpTo2: Choose up to two — your two permanent creation benefits. (The familiar trades both.)
RIPPERS.Benefit.Contested: Contested — one character in the party may take this.
RIPPERS.Builder.Title: Guise Builder
RIPPERS.Builder.Name: Name
RIPPERS.Builder.NoSkills: No skills recorded for this class.
RIPPERS.Builder.PickClassFirst: Pick at least one class on the Classes step first.
RIPPERS.Builder.ModeInnate: The Innate Guise (the face under the masks)
RIPPERS.Builder.ModeWornHint: A mask distilled from a monster: three classes, equipment, an affinity trio, a Perk, a +3 Bonus, a Tell and a narrative bane.
RIPPERS.Builder.ModeInnateHint: Your base self: three innate classes, two Specialties, and one creation Heroic. No armour or hands (it carries the Hunter Weapon), no affinities, no Nature, Tell or Perk.
RIPPERS.Builder.NatureHint: the Guise's identity — the face it wears
RIPPERS.Builder.TrioHint: A guise inherits its source monster's affinities: at most one Immunity — which must be paired with a Vulnerability — and one Resistance. A guise never grants Absorption.
RIPPERS.Builder.AffInnateNone: The Innate Guise has no affinity modifiers — it keeps your own.
RIPPERS.Builder.AffNoneReview: None — this guise keeps the wearer's own affinities.
RIPPERS.Builder.EquipmentHint: Drag a weapon, shield, armour or accessory here — an attached armour, two hands, and an accessory.
RIPPERS.Builder.DropEquip: Drag an item here to attach it
RIPPERS.Builder.PerksHint: Free flavour, inherited from the source monster. A Perk answers "can you?", never "how well?".
RIPPERS.Builder.BonusProvisional: Proposed taxonomy — Austin to confirm the check-type list and how it applies.
RIPPERS.Builder.BaneHint: the material that harms the source monster (silver, cold iron, running water…)
RIPPERS.Builder.SpecialtiesHint: Choose exactly two. In an in-subject Check, improve one die's size.
RIPPERS.Builder.InnateHeroicHint: One Heroic Skill, attached to the Innate Guise (it sleeps while you wear a mask). Banned-at-creation heroics are refused.
RIPPERS.Clot.OverSockets: "{name}" has {capacity} Clot socket(s) at this level; that loadout needs {needed}.
RIPPERS.Clot.OverImmunity: A character may carry at most two Clot-granted Immunities across all weapons and armor; this loadout would make {total}.
RIPPERS.Clot.SlotHost: Slot a Clot onto a custom weapon or armor.
